notes: faces right, anchor = centre of the base. hurtbox = the mass; weakpoint = the maw (optional bonus-damage zone). slam: near arm raised overhead (frames 1-3, hold on 3) then brought down, active 5-6; spawn.slam = impact point on the floor (shockwave / fx_rot_wave both ways). sweep: both arms raised wide (hold on 3) then raked outward along the floor to BOTH sides, active 4-5, hit spans the whole base. spew: rears back and swells (frames 1-4), vomits on 6; engine spawns proj_rotglob / fx_rot_wave at spawn.spew (the drawn gush is visual only). crawl is a loop drawn in place.
